## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — mixed signals across cyclical tech and materials vs. pockets of defensive weakness.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leading: TXN (1W: +26.50% | 1M: +45.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.73% | 1M: +48.67%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: NUE (1W: +11.00% | 1M: +31.30%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing resilience: PM (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Healthcare lagging: DHR (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.66% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak and Communication under pressure: NFLX (1W: -13.89% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION — these sectors are dragging overall breadth.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: TXN (1W: +26.50% | 1M: +45.01%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +12.06% | 1M: +30.22%) ABOVE TREND; NUE (1W: +11.00% | 1M: +31.30%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +9.73% | 1M: +48.67%) ABOVE TREND; CAT (1W: +8.31% | 1M: +16.77%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — not concentrated in a single theme.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -18.99%) BELOW TREND; LMT (1W: -12.79% | 1M: -13.17%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -3.95%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND; DHR (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and large-cap software.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: TXN (1W: +26.50%), UNH (1W: +12.06%), NUE (1W: +11.00%), AMD (1W: +9.73%), CAT (1W: +8.31%) — strong short-term flows. Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M such as MSFT, META, V) — watch for trend break and tactical setups rather than broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but constructive: AAPL (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +8.66%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.73% | 1M: +48.67%) ABOVE TREND contrasted with MSFT (1W: -1.07% | 1M: +11.54%) CORRECTION and IBM (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -3.95%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation within Tech.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed/soft: JPM (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +7.14%) ABOVE TREND while card names show short-term fatigue — V (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.12% | 1M: +0.86%) CORRECTION; sector 1W is negative, so watch for leadership failure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Split: UNH (1W: +12.06% | 1M: +30.22%) ABOVE TREND is a clear leader but broader Healthcare is soft — DHR (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -9.55% | 1M: -4.81%) BELOW TREND — defensive bid limited to specific names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Maintain balanced exposure given NEUTRAL regime; favor names showing confirmed strength (TXN, AMD, NUE, UNH) and reduce exposure to structurally weak names (NOW, IBM, LMT) while monitoring short-term dispersion. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective as leadership is broad but breath thin.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: TXN (1W: +26.50% | 1M: +45.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.73% | 1M: +48.67%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +12.06% | 1M: +30.22%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -18.99%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -3.95%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -13.89% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology and Materials (momentum in TXN/AMD/NUE). BEARISH: Healthcare and Communication (broader Selling beyond isolated winners).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch TXN for continuation above its recent breakout high to confirm follow-through and sustain ABOVE TREND; monitor NVDA for confirmed 1W follow-through to remain ABOVE TREND; NOW needs to reclaim short-term support to negate BELOW TREND; UNH momentum needs hold of the week’s gap to reinforce ABOVE TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TXN (+60): PT hike and bullish headlines; price confirming — TXN (1W: +26.50% | 1M: +45.01%) ABOVE TREND (sentiment confirmed). AMAT (+60): AI supply comments — monitor for price follow-through (not in top list). FCX (+55): Q1 beat but price mixed — FCX (1W: -9.96% | 1M: +9.09%) CORRECTION (news vs price diverging).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
IBM (-60): negative results and AI concern — IBM (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -3.95%) BELOW TREND (sentiment confirmed). LMT (-55): profit miss — LMT (1W: -12.79% | 1M: -13.17%) BELOW TREND (confirmed). NOW (-45): renewed AI concerns — NOW (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -18.99%) BELOW TREND (confirmed).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. TXN (1W: +26.50% | 1M: +45.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.73% | 1M: +48.67%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +12.06% | 1M: +30.22%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (MSFT, META, V, MA, NOW) and mixed sentiment (bullish headlines for TXN/AMAT but confirmed weakness in IBM/NOW) — watch for trend confirmation.
